comment: Curated wire idiosyncrasies, injected by generate.py --coverage as a
dedicated Quirks tab (separate from the systematic item.h sweep).
Each entry: id; status (verified-in-data = seen in real wire data we
inspected ourselves - a userstore survey or archived public-stash
captures; documented = developer docs / changelog / confirmed by GGG;
reported = firsthand account or issue tracker; community = third-party
tool workaround or relayed capture we did not re-inspect); source;
description; and either an 'item' object (merged into a generated
rare's JSON - unknown keys are deliberate, they exercise tolerant
parsing; null deletes a key, the string "__null__" emits a literal
JSON null), or 'tab'/'tabs' objects (each emitted as
its own empty stash tab, so metadata quirks do not overwrite each
other).
Provenance rules: 'source' holds durable references only - URLs with
dates, issue numbers, forum thread ids, files in this repository.
Evidence that cannot be linked or committed gets an 'inspected'
record instead: who looked, when, the exact observation, and whether
it can be rechecked. Entries that probe tolerance with a plausible
shape we hold no captured bytes for carry 'stress_case': true - they
assert 'the application should tolerate this', not 'GGG is known to
have emitted this'.
Named corpora: '2016 corpus' = the real 4,658-item public-stash feed
embedded in https://web.archive.org/web/20161015001652/http://www.pathofexile.com/developer/docs/api-resource-public-stash-tabs
(mined and re-verified locally, Aug 8 2026; requires a non-strict
JSON parser - the bytes carry raw control characters, which is itself
a quirk). 'userstore survey' = a contributor's real 3.10-era Standard
account (43k items) scanned with tools/synthdata/quirks.py; the
database is private and never committed, so survey observations carry
inspected records.

quirks.source: src/util/util.cpp GetTabColor (padding logic, GGG-confirmed leading-zero stripping); https://github.com/shonya3/divicards test fixtures; maintainer report (gerwaric, Discord, Aug 8 2026)
quirks.description: Stash tab colour hex strings arrive with leading zeros stripped: 'ff' means 0000ff, 'bf00' means 00bf00.

quirks.source: gerwaric/acquisition#43; docs/cleanup/findings.md F51 (~30 unnamed tabs on a real account)
quirks.description: Tab names can be the empty string; name is unusable as a key, only id is.

quirks.source: https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Remove-only (server-side rename at league merge)

inspected.observation: third-party 1135-tab account dump: ~900 names end ' (Remove-only)'; duplicate names present, including Latin '1c' vs Cyrillic '1с'

quirks.description: GGG mutates tab names server-side; duplicates and homoglyph collisions are normal.

quirks.source: userstore survey (see comment)

inspected.observation: 50 of 43k items carry frameType but no frameTypeId key
inspected.recheckable: yes - rerun tools/synthdata/quirks.py against any pre-3.29 store

quirks.description: Items cached before the field existed carry frameType but no frameTypeId.

quirks.source: src/poe/types/itemmod.h custom-reader comment (maintainer-confirmed with a GGG web developer, pre-3.29: PHP json_encode of an empty associative array)
quirks.description: GGG's serializer encodes a mod with no flags as "flags": [] instead of an object.

quirks.source: 2016 corpus (see comment): socketed gems carry socket/colour, no x/y/inventoryId

inspected.observation: userstore survey: 1,650 socketed gems with legacy socket (index) and colour (S/D/I/G) fields
inspected.recheckable: yes - rerun tools/synthdata/quirks.py against a store with socketed gems

quirks.description: Socketed gems carry legacy socket (index) and colour (S/D/I/G attribute, not R/G/B/W) fields, and no x/y/inventoryId.

quirks.source: 2016 corpus (see comment): 337 gems with "support": false; developer docs annotate support 'always true if present'
quirks.description: support is documented always-true-if-present but the wire sends explicit false on active gems.

quirks.source: 2016 corpus (see comment): corrupted:false on 4,136 and lockedToCharacter:false on all 4,658 items; modern wire omits false flags
quirks.description: Era-old captures emit optional booleans explicitly false where modern payloads omit them.

quirks.source: 2016 corpus (see comment): 4,468 socket objects, zero sColour (field added ~3.1, Dec 2017)
quirks.description: Pre-3.1 sockets are {group, attr} only; sColour does not exist.

quirks.source: src/poe/types/itemsocket.h vocabulary (DV, A, W); https://github.com/briansd9/exile-diary (replaces 'DV' with 'D' before counting)
quirks.description: attr can be two characters (DV = resonator) or A (abyssal); the letter G means white in attr but green in sColour. The exact combination emitted here is a constructed probe, not captured bytes.

quirks.source: 2016 corpus (see comment): 2,857 names / 355 typeLines prefixed; removed by GGG in 3.4.3e but persisted data keeps it (src/item.cpp fixup_name)
quirks.description: name and typeLine carry the <<set:MS>><<set:M>><<set:S>> localisation prefix on pre-3.5 captures.

quirks.source: 2016 corpus (see comment): 2,440 of 3,668 flavour lines end in bare \r

inspected.observation: userstore survey: multi-line mod descriptions embed \r\n inside one description string
inspected.recheckable: yes - rerun tools/synthdata/quirks.py / jq over any real store

quirks.description: Multi-line mod descriptions embed \r\n inside one description string; flavour text lines end in bare \r and split mid-sentence.

flavourText: "Exiled to the sea; what a joke.
I'm more free than I've ever been."

quirks.source: 2016 corpus (see comment): 14,304/14,304 value pairs are (string, int); 1,181 properties with values []; units and ranges baked into the string
quirks.description: Property values are [[string, int]] tuples - always strings even for pure numbers, with +/%/(Max)/n-m/n/m baked in; values can be empty; the int is an undocumented colour code.

quirks.source: https://github.com/poe-vela/poe-custom-elements (parseDisplayMode3 handles both %0 and {0} syntaxes)

inspected.observation: out-of-order substitution indices ({1} before {0}) present in a third-party raw dump

quirks.description: displayMode 3 makes name a format string; %0 and {0} syntaxes both occur and indices can be out of order.

inspected.observation: one third-party dataset: Int x162 vs Intelligence x9, Dex x152 vs Dexterity x3, Str x129 vs Strength x1, plus 'Class:' with trailing colon, within one payload

quirks.description: Requirement names are inconsistent for the same stat within one payload.

quirks.source: 2016 corpus (see comment): progress values like 3.49876677319e-06 despite docs claiming 2 decimal places
quirks.description: additionalProperties progress arrives at 12 significant figures, scientific notation included, and int 1 vs float for the same field.

quirks.source: 2016 corpus (see comment): talismanTier 1-4 on 328 items; documented in the developer docs until removed in 3.29.0; never modeled in src/poe/types/item.h
quirks.description: Old items carry keys the app has never modeled; the tolerant reader must skip them and the raw cache must preserve them.

quirks.source: developer docs list frameType 8 as the legacy Prophecy tombstone; docs say prophecyText is ?string while src/poe/types/item.h models array-of-string - no real prophecy payload exists in any corpus we hold (userstore survey: 0; 2016 corpus: 0), so the true wire shape is UNRESOLVED and this entry follows the app model. prophecyDiffText pairs with it (PoE wiki 2017; Procurement fixtures) but is absent from current docs and item.h
quirks.description: Prophecy items (2.3-3.17) survive on Standard with prophecyText and frameType 8, predating frameTypeId.

quirks.source: standalone elder/shaper booleans shipped 3.0-3.8 before the influences object (3.9); both still ship; src/item.cpp LoadInfluences merges five sources

inspected.observation: userstore survey: top-level elder/shaper booleans present alongside (and without) the influences object
inspected.recheckable: yes - jq over any store holding 3.0-3.8-era items

quirks.description: Pre-3.9 items carry top-level elder/shaper true with no influences object; searing/tangled never joined influences.

quirks.source: xyzz/acquisition#11 (Vaal gems invisible until the hybrid.baseTypeName rule); https://github.com/briansd9/exile-diary tests the typeLine 'Vaal' prefix instead
quirks.description: Vaal gems nest the real base name and a second property list under hybrid; typeLine alone misleads.

quirks.source: https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2936225 (present on 5-digit stacks, rounded textual form)
quirks.description: stackSizeText appears only above 9999 and is a lossy abbreviation of stackSize.

inspected.observation: third-party dumps: stackSize 209 / maxStackSize 5000 / Stack Size property '209/20' (20 = per-slot display cap); a div card at 36/3. Behaviour independently confirmed in this repo: Item::m_count reads the property string, not stackSize (src/item.cpp)

quirks.description: stackSize, maxStackSize, and the Stack Size property text are three mutually inconsistent numbers.

quirks.source: 2016 corpus (see comment): 100% http:// icons with ?scale/w/h/v params; modern forms are https gen/image base64 or relative paths
quirks.description: Old captures use http:// icon URLs; URL form drifted twice since and query params carry semantics (mb=1 = blighted, relic=1).

quirks.source: 2016 corpus (see comment): 195 items with bare artFilename (no path, no extension)
quirks.description: Divination cards carry artFilename as a bare filename.

quirks.source: web.archive.org captures of pathofexile.com/developer/docs/api-resource-public-stash-tabs, 2017-2019 (embedded feeds): category polymorphic - bare string then object of arrays, arrays may be empty; removed in 3.26.0; unmodeled in src/poe/types/item.h
quirks.description: The removed top-level category key survives in old captures as an object of arrays (and once shipped as a bare string).

quirks.source: https://github.com/viktorgullmark/exilence-next (guards properties/sockets against null despite non-optional types); /trade/fetch is known to return null array elements

inspected.observation: one relayed abyss-jewel capture with colour: null; the raw bytes were not retained

quirks.description: Fields documented as optional arrays can arrive as JSON null rather than absent.

quirks.source: src/poe/types/item.h comment documents monsterLevel as string

inspected.observation: userstore survey: 17k items carry monsterLevel as a JSON int
inspected.recheckable: yes - tools/synthdata/quirks.py reports mixed-type keys on any store

quirks.description: Field types drift between docs and wire; monsterLevel is documented as string but arrives as an int.

quirks.source: developer docs: crucible.nodes is an object keyed by stringified ints, not an array

inspected.observation: userstore survey: 67 items with crucible trees, all parked in Standard
inspected.recheckable: yes - jq over any Standard store that played 3.21

quirks.description: Crucible (3.21) mod trees exist only on items parked in Standard; every retired league mechanic migrates there permanently.
